name: Safeguard Amulet banishes itself to prevent 4 non-combat damage to the champion
notes: Safeguard Amulet's element is NORM, so no lineage patch is needed; it is seeded directly onto the field (REGALIA convention). Its ability is banish-self at zero reserve cost: a single CustomInput Activate click tags the champion with a prevent-4-non-combat-damage turn effect and moves the amulet to myBanish. Activating it opens a reactive opportunity window (this particular hand draw happens to contain a reaction-speed card) that is declined with a single P1 PASS before continuing. Nascent Blast (also NORM) is then played and its own MZCHOOSE target is pointed at our own champion (myField-0 -- 'target unit' allows targeting your own side) instead of an opponent's ally, dealing 3 non-combat damage that the prevention fully absorbs. Because 3 < 4, the exact 4-point prevention ceiling isn't independently proven here, only that the 3 damage dealt is fully prevented.

rulesClauses: Banish CARDNAME: If your champion would take non-combat damage this turn, prevent 4 of that damage.
